messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — ACME Health onboarding just pinged us with their vendor risk form. They want DPA scope + SOC2 evidence + a clear answer on embeddings retention and pseudonymization. Also asked whether customers can BYOK for KMS.

Ankit Rao: I can own the embeddings retention answer. We currently retain embeddings for up to 90 days by default unless customer requests shorter retention. We do support per-tenant retention settings on Private/Dedicated.

Jordan Lee: For Hosted API customers we have a retention opt-out for embeddings? I thought only Dedicated/Private had per-tenant retention controls.

Ankit Rao: Correct — hosted has default 90d but we can escalate via CS+Legal for exceptions. Dedicated/Private -> configurable.

Priya Singh: Legal note: ACME also asked about pseudonymization and whether we store any PII in embeddings. We should provide the standard language: "embeddings are derived from input text and treated as customer data; we do not attempt to reverse-engineer PII; you can request deletion." I'll draft.

Maya Patel: Sounds good. Also specify KMS BYOK support + key provenance for Private and Dedicated. Customer specifically wants to confirm BYOK for embeddings at rest.

Jordan Lee: Technical confirmation: Dedicated + Private support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and we encrypt model outputs & embeddings at rest with that key. Hosted supports KMS for encryption-at-rest via our managed KMS only (no BYOK) unless we set up a private deployment.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Priya — can you add the exact legal phrasing and any policy exceptions? I'll forward to ACME.

LegalBot: Auto: Attached standard DPA excerpt for embeddings handling and BYOK wording uploaded: https://redwood-docs.internal/dpa-excerpts/embeddings-byok-v1.pdf

Priya Singh: Draft below — please review: "Redwood treats embeddings as Customer Data. Embeddings are not subject to automated re-identification efforts. Customers may request deletion or reduced retention. For Dedicated and Private deployments, customers may provide customer-managed keys (BYOK) for encryption-at-rest. For Hosted tier, Redwood-managed encryption keys are used unless otherwise agreed in the contract."

Ankit Rao: That's clear. I'll add a short tech annotation about pseudonymization: we recommend customers remove or hash direct identifiers prior to embedding for extra safety.

Maya Patel: ACME also needs a data flow diagram and sample SOC2 evidence (covering logging, ACLs, access reviews) — can eng share the diagram and the evidence bundle we normally give for onboarding?

Jordan Lee: I'll export the onboarding dataflow from Confluence and share a sanitized SVG. Also will bundle SOC2 evidence index (control mappings + sample screenshots).

Jordan Lee: Uploading evidence bundle to S3 presigned link now.

LegalBot: Auto: Evidence bundle uploaded by Jordan Lee to s3://redwood-evidence/acme-onboarding/1764123456-evidence.zip (presigned link expires in 7 days).

Jordan Lee: Presigned command I used for reproducibility:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-onboarding/1764123456-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```

Maya Patel: Awesome. Can we also schedule a 30-min enablement call with ACME security? Propose Fri 10am PST, 30m, go over DPA items + SOC2 evidence.

Priya Singh: I'm available Fri 10am PST. Ankit/Jordan?

Ankit Rao: Works for me.

Jordan Lee: Yup. I'll bring the dataflow and sample screenshots.

Maya Patel: I'll send calendar invite and include the presigned link + the drafted legal phrasing.

Priya Singh: One more ask — ACME wants to know if we run periodic embeddings drift or quality monitoring that would store evaluation prompts. We should clarify evaluation storage cadence.

Ankit Rao: We run evaluation traces for quality monitoring; those traces are stored for 60 days by default and are accessible to internal SRE/ML teams. We can redact customer content on request.

Maya Patel: Noted. I'll add that to the response.

Priya Singh: Final action items: 1) Legal to finalize phrasing (Priya) 2) Engineering to provide dataflow + evidence bundle (Jordan) 3) CS to confirm retention and escalate hosted exceptions if needed (Maya/Ankit).

Maya Patel: Thanks all. I'll file a renewal-risk flag if onboarding drags beyond the contract start date (low -> medium risk if evidence delayed >7 days). :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: Uploaded SVG + evidence link to the thread: https://redwood-docs.internal/confluence/acme-dataflow.svg and presigned link above.

Priya Singh: Draft sent to Maya for sign-off, @Maya Patel please ACK and I'll hand off to you to send to ACME.

Maya Patel: ACK — I'll send after I attach the evidence link. Invite sent. Closing thread after ACME confirm. :rocket:
